zones: all zones traversed by a linked object
costs: cards exiled to pay a permanent spell cost
timing: ability-pair recognition from printed or jointly granted text
link fact captured when the first ability acts or a cost is declared
second ability resolves only against its link
choices: one of multiple linked exiled cards
hidden_information: linked exile and pre-game records expose only information allowed by the effect
a private choice remains seat-scoped until rules make it public
layers: acquired ability pairs remain linked only when granted by the same effect
replacement_effects: cards exiled by one specific replacement event are linked to its paired ability
copy: copied linked abilities and multiple exiled cards preserve the exact relationship required by CR 607.3
nonmodal double-faced object faces share printed-object link recognition
control_change: linked relationship remains on the represented object independently of controller
zone_change: ordinary linked object references do not follow a new logical incarnation
pre-game characteristic choices can explicitly persist across zones
a permanent spell and the permanent it becomes can share a cast-cost link
source_leaves: a linked ability uses only the relationship captured by its paired ability

variants: created or put onto battlefield with this object

implementation.component: CardInstance annotations and logical incarnation guards in CommanderEngine

known_blockers: the Oracle IR does not assign stable ability-pair and link identifiers
linked exiled-card sets, noted information, chosen words, and cost facts are not represented generically
copy, double-faced, token, emblem, and cross-object linked relationships are incomplete
multiple-card link expansion and sum semantics are not implemented generically
jointly granted ability-pair provenance is not tracked
undefined choice behavior is implemented only by selected consumers
